name: Sebastian Reed
preparty_markdown:
Sebastian is the youngest scholar attached to the exhibition and has been trying very hard to behave like this

is normal. He is brilliant, earnest, slightly overprepared, and burdened with the knowledge that every person

here could someday write a recommendation letter or ruin his evening.

HOW TO PLAY THEM

Eager, cerebral, anxious in a useful way, unexpectedly bold when the evidence is on your side.

WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW

• Doctoral student of Marcus Pryce.

• Mentored informally by Celeste Frame.

• Maya Bell keeps rescuing Sebastian from conversations with donors who ask whether art history is a real degree.

COSTUME

Best-suit energy: formal but slightly less effortless than the veterans. Add glasses, notebook, museum catalogue full of tabs.

OPTIONAL QUIPS

“I have a footnote for that, which I realize is not helping.”

“Technically I am not nervous. I am pre-defending my dissertation.”

name: Malcolm Carrara
preparty_markdown:
Malcolm makes monumental sculpture in stone, steel, and whatever else can require a crane. He is

charismatic, physically expressive, and convinced that architecture should know when to get out of

sculpture's way. His newest commission occupies the museum entrance and at least three opinions per

square foot.

HOW TO PLAY THEM

Big presence, playful arrogance, generous when admired, combative when minimized.

WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW

• Creative rival of Lucian Gable after an argument about the entrance installation.

• Friendly competitor of Julian Brush.

• Riley Bloom once designed a gala around one of Malcolm's sculptures and still talks about the insurance.

COSTUME

Bold formalwear, chunky ring, sculptural accessories, dark shirt with jacket, perhaps a dust-marked work boot paired with

gala clothes.

OPTIONAL QUIPS

“If it fits through a normal door, I am still thinking.”

“Architecture is sculpture that got a permit.”

name: Daphne Palette
preparty_markdown:
Daphne has excellent taste, excellent photographers, and excellent instincts about which artists will become

impossible to buy next year. She hosts salons, funds commissions, and somehow makes every acquisition look

accidental. Beneath the polish, she is a serious collector who remembers exactly who dismissed what five

years ago.

HOW TO PLAY THEM

Charming, strategic, stylish, lightly competitive. Compliments can be sincere and still accomplish something.

WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW

• Collects work by Julian Brush and Lola Loom.

• Competes socially and at auction with Theo Glass.

• Uses Grant Easel when discretion matters and Conrad Gavel when spectacle does.

COSTUME

Fashion-forward gala look, statement jewelry, dramatic clutch, bold color or silhouette. Aim for 'photographed on arrival.'

OPTIONAL QUIPS

“I never chase trends. I simply arrive before they admit they are trends.”

“It is not a bidding war if I win quickly.”
